sources: https://www.alpenacounty.org/DocumentCenter/View/1452 (2026 Fairgrounds Rental Lease Fees, Board Approved 2026 County Fee Schedule 01.02.26)

values.note: Alpena County 2026 fee schedule: campsites $35 a night, $230 a week, $1,800 a season, one rate for everyone (no resident discount stated); rates exclude the $5 booking fee. Campspot quoted $35 + $5 booking fee in October 2026. A one-night deposit (two for holiday stays) is required to reserve, with no refunds (a deposit may move to a later stay that season). Non-campers pay $10 to dump and $5 to shower.

fees.source: https://www.alpenacounty.org/DocumentCenter/View/1452 ('Trailer Parking – Campsites 1-60 campsites - $35 per site; Weekly campsite - $230 per site per week; Seasonal campsite - $1,800 per site per season'; 'Rates do not include the $5.00 Booking Fee'; 'All reservations require a minimum of a one-night deposit, with a two-night deposit required for all Holiday stays. Alpena County has a no refund policy') + Campspot quote for 2026-10-14, read 2026-10-22

values.note: 69 campsites with power, 12 directly on the Thunder Bay River (county). Campspot sells 68 RV sites nightly in six types (30-amp, 50-amp, waterfront 30- and 50-amp, pop-up/small camper); some pull-through.

sites.source: https://www.alpenacounty.org/Facilities/Facility/Details/Alpena-County-Fairgrounds-5 ('We offer 69 campsites with power, 12 sites directly on the river') + Campspot site types ('Pull-Through' on the 30 amp, 30 amp Waterfront and 50 amp types), read 2026-10-13/2026-10-22

values.note: Holding-tank disposal on site. Two free boat launches to the Thunder Bay River; horse boarding barn and arena for campers.

facilities.source: https://www.alpenacounty.org/Facilities/Facility/Details/Alpena-County-Fairgrounds-5 ('showers, and a holding tank disposal area on site'; 'two free boat launches'; 'we offer a boarding barn and arena for all campers'), read 2026-10-22

booking.source: Campspot park record for alpena-county-fairgrounds (operator's engine; park's own site field points to the county facility page), read 2026-10-13; county fee schedule ('NO DATES WILL BE RESERVED WITHOUT DEPOSIT PAYMENT'), read 2026-10-22

summary: County-run (Alpena County government facility page and fee schedule), so ownership local is right. Confirmed $35/night (2026 county schedule, one rate, no resident discount) + $5 booking fee, 69 powered sites (12 on the river), pull-throughs, showers, dump, reservable on Campspot; 50-amp already confirmed. Weekly $230 and seasonal $1,800 sites exist, but Campspot sells 68 RV sites nightly, so not mostly seasonal. Season left as recorded (no campground dates stated; Campspot closed bookings from 2026-10-16). max_rig_ft 50 (derived) left: the county is silent and Campspot's site lengths (48-137 ft) look like pad lengths but do not contradict it. Fair week (2026: Aug 15-22) not addressed on any county page.
flags: Website is the Campspot /park/ marketplace page; the operator's own page is https://www.alpenacounty.org/Facilities/Facility/Details/Alpena-County-Fairgrounds-5 and the booking link https://www.campspot.com/book/alpena-county-fairgrounds.
Phone: the county facility page and Campspot give 989-356-1847; the entry has 989-354-6016, which appears on neither.

Fair week: no county page says whether the campground stays open to the public during the Alpena County Fair (Aug 15-22, 2026). The schedule prices nightly, weekly and seasonal sites for the whole camping season and Campspot sold nightly sites into mid-October, so it is an ordinary public campground, not fair-week-only.
